Freeze table headers and first columns

Source: R/freeze_tables.R
use_freeze_tables.Rd

Makes the header row and/or the first column of tables rendered with teal.widgets::table_with_settings_ui() sticky, so that the headers and row labels stay visible while scrolling. Include the returned tags once in the app UI, e.g. in the header argument of teal::init().

Usage 

use_freeze_tables(
  freeze_header = TRUE,
  freeze_col = TRUE,
  max_height = "70vh",
  module_ids = NULL
)

Arguments

freeze_header

(logical(1)) whether to freeze the header rows of the tables.

freeze_col

(logical(1)) whether to freeze the first column of the tables.

max_height

(character(1)) a CSS value for the maximum height of the table container. The table scrolls vertically inside the container when it is taller than that.

module_ids

(character or NULL) if NULL, all tables in the app are frozen. Otherwise, only tables inside elements whose id contains any of the provided strings are frozen (e.g. the ids of teal modules).

Value

A shiny::tagList() with the CSS and the JavaScript freezing the tables.

Details

rtables renders tables without a <thead> element, so the header rows cannot be selected with CSS alone. The JavaScript watches the page for new tables and moves the leading rows containing <th> cells into a <thead> element of every matching table. Once https://github.com/pharmaverse/rtables/issues/1123 is resolved, this can be simplified.

Examples 

library(teal.modules.clinical)
data <- teal_data()
data <- within(data, {
  ADSL <- tmc_ex_adsl
})
join_keys(data) <- default_cdisc_join_keys[names(data)]

app <- init(
  data = data,
  modules = modules(
    tm_t_summary(
      label = "Demographic Table",
      dataname = "ADSL",
      arm_var = choices_selected(c("ARM", "ARMCD"), "ARM"),
      add_total = TRUE,
      summarize_vars = choices_selected(
        c("SEX", "RACE", "BMRKR2", "EOSDY", "DCSREAS", "AGE"),
        c("SEX", "RACE")
      ),
      useNA = "ifany"
    )
  ),
  header = use_freeze_tables(freeze_header = TRUE, freeze_col = TRUE)
)
#> Initializing tm_t_summary

if (interactive()) {
  shiny::shinyApp(app$ui, app$server)
}
